scope: Nine historical-figure carousel identities for a fictional Three Kingdoms chess presentation, not one distinct person per chess token.
display_note_zh: 汉末三国群英集结，采用各人生涯代表身份，并非同一年在任阵容。
portrait_note_zh: 历史题材美术形象，非史实肖像复原。

roles.name: 曹操
roles.caution: 曹操生前不是曹魏皇帝；不要为了阵营统一将其标为魏帝。

roles.name: 荀彧
roles.caution: 尚书令不是丞相；阵营归属为曹操阵营的题材化分类。

roles.name: 司马懿
roles.caution: 采用曹魏时期太傅身份，不使用后世追尊的晋帝身份；太傅身份晚于曹操生前。

roles.name: 诸葛亮
roles.caution: 诸葛亮确实任丞相，但该职晚于庞统在世年代。

roles.name: 周瑜
roles.historicalOffice: 前部大督；偏将军、南郡太守
roles.caution: “都督”为易懂的统帅标签，不应称丞相。若显示严格官名，使用前部大督或偏将军。

roles.name: 鲁肃
roles.historicalOffice: 赞军校尉；后为奋武校尉、汉昌太守、偏将军、横江将军
roles.caution: 鲁肃不是丞相，也不只是文弱的献策者；其后实际领兵。

uiRules: Use full names and full terms, never 主/士/相 as unexplained abbreviations.
Keep historical identity labels independent from chess movement classes.
Do not label Rusu, Xun Yu, Sima Yi, Pang Tong, or Zhou Yu as chancellor merely for symmetry.
Represent the roster as an anthology across Han-end and Three Kingdoms lifetimes, not an exact-year reconstruction.
Do not claim clothing, hair, face, props, or colors are authenticated portraits.
